ExportGear.name: Fass Residue
ExportGear.description:
A chunk of the wyrm Fass, collected after his explosive death in the Cambion Drift. Used to attract Glutinox on the surface during Vome, Ostimyr at surface hotspots during Fass, and Vitreospina in caves during Fass/Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Vome is active

ExportGear.name: Processed Fass Residue
ExportGear.description:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).

ExportGear.name: Vome Residue
ExportGear.description:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active

ExportGear.name: Processed Vome Residue
ExportGear.description:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).

ExportGear.name: Mirewinder Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is composed of aromatic tetraxin that is known to attract Mirewinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Charamote Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Synathid Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Broad-Spectrum Bait
ExportGear.description:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Kriller Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Longwinder Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is synthesized from beryzene that is known to attract Longwinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Narrow-Spectrum Bait
ExportGear.description:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Tromyzon Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportGear.name: Murkray Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Murkrays, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during both day and night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

ExportGear.name: Twilight Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait attracts predatory fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during either day or night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Sharrac and Karkina in the ocean.

ExportGear.name: Peppered Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.

ExportGear.name: Glappid Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

ExportGear.name: Norg Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Norg, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon lake hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

ExportGear.name: Cuthol Bait
ExportGear.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Cuthols, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

ExportKeys.name: The Lotus Eaters
ExportKeys.description: A strange call comes from beyond and must not go unanswered.

ExportKeys.name: The Hex Finale
ExportKeys.description: A chance to rewrite history and avert disaster.

ExportKeys.name: The Hex
ExportKeys.description: The desperate hunt for Albrecht Entrati has led the Drifter to the city of Höllvania on December 31st, 1999. Despite the Scaldra lockdown in the face of the Techrot menace, the citizens do their best to celebrate. But this has all happened before... and ended in disaster.

ExportKeys.name: Apostasy Prologue
ExportKeys.description: Inspect your personal quarters upon finishing the Chains of Harrow quest.

ExportKeys.name: The Archwing
ExportKeys.description: The Balor Fomorians are coming but we are ready. Through your efforts we finally have a working Archwing prototype and I am sending you the blueprint. However, your task is not yet complete. You still must discover the component parts.

ExportKeys.name: Octavia's Anthem
ExportKeys.description: Build the Mandachord and find the cause of Cephalon Suda’s erratic behavior.

ExportKeys.name: Chimera Prologue
ExportKeys.description: Investigate your personal quarters upon completion of The Sacrifice.

ExportKeys.name: The New Strange
ExportKeys.description: Work with Cephalon Simaris to find the source of a mysterious voice.

ExportKeys.name: The Duviri Paradox
ExportKeys.description: Enter the Kingdom of Duviri

ExportKeys.name: Whispers in the Walls
ExportKeys.description: Loid has had strange dreams and desperately needs to show you something.

ExportKeys.name: The Silver Grove
ExportKeys.description: New Loka seeks help protecting a sacred forest from Grineer incursions, but are they ready to face the forest’s true nature?

ExportKeys.name: A Man of Few Words
ExportKeys.description: Darvo needs your help again. Save one of his best contractors from Grineer execution.

ExportKeys.name: Saya's Vigil
ExportKeys.description: On the Plains of Eidolon a mystery has lain buried for years: one that will mend or destroy a heart, and open the door to a hidden past.

ExportKeys.name: The Jordas Precept
ExportKeys.description: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.

ExportKeys.name: The Glast Gambit
ExportKeys.description: Nef Anyo has stolen the children of the Mycona Colony and it is up to you to get them back. You must challenge Nef on The Index and beat him at his own game. But Tenno, beware, not all is as it seems.

ExportKeys.name: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate
ExportKeys.description: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments

ExportKeys.name: Patient Zero
ExportKeys.description: Find Alad V’s laboratory and put a stop to his madness.

ExportKeys.name: Once Awake
ExportKeys.description: Intercepted Grineer communications reveal that Grineer have been experimenting with some sort of bio weapon. You must investigate.

ExportKeys.name: Heart of Deimos
ExportKeys.description: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...

ExportKeys.name: Jade Shadows
ExportKeys.description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.

ExportKeys.name: Veilbreaker
ExportKeys.description: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.

ExportKeys.name: Howl of the Kubrow
ExportKeys.description: You are Tenno, you deserve a Kubrow by your side.

ExportKeys.name: The Limbo Theorem
ExportKeys.description:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source

ExportKeys.name: Hidden Messages
ExportKeys.description: Seek out the Warframe Mirage.

ExportKeys.name: The Teacher
ExportKeys.description: Corpus incursions into Grineer territory lead to showdown with a forgotten rival.

ExportKeys.name: Sands of Inaros
ExportKeys.description: Help Baro Ki'Teer raid an ancient Martian tomb for a mysterious treasure.

ExportKeys.name: AWAKENING
ExportKeys.description:
The Tenno: monuments of an ancient warrior caste.

For generations you've slept, with no call to wake you.

Until now.

ExportKeys.name: The New War
ExportKeys.description:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.

ExportKeys.name: The Second Dream
ExportKeys.description: The Sentient Hunhow seeks to destroy the Tenno by exploiting long forgotten secrets.

ExportKeys.name: Chains of Harrow
ExportKeys.description: A strange transmission leads deep into the dark world of Red Veil mysticism. What evils will be found there and what do they want?

ExportKeys.name: The Deadlock Protocol
ExportKeys.description: A power struggle within the Corpus elite has erupted. Seeking control, Nef Anyo looks to the past... to the very origins of the Corpus itself.

ExportKeys.name: Rising Tide
ExportKeys.description: To face a growing threat, a long dormant Cephalon calls on you to reconstruct an Orokin-era interceptor craft: the Railjack.

ExportKeys.name: Mask of the Revenant
ExportKeys.description: The Unum chooses Nakak to receive a strange mask. A mask that leads to even stranger visions. What lost story does the Unum want to tell?

ExportKeys.name: The Sacrifice
ExportKeys.description: A tortured vision sends the Operator on the hunt for a Warframe unlike any other.

ExportKeys.name: Natah
ExportKeys.description: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.

ExportKeys.name: Vox Solaris
ExportKeys.description: Eudico would do anything to keep her people safe, but will she stand up to Nef Anyo?

ExportKeys.name: Stolen Dreams
ExportKeys.description: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.

ExportKeys.name: The Old Peace
ExportKeys.description: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.

ExportKeys.name: Vor's Prize
ExportKeys.description:
MY QUEENS -

You were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR

ExportKeys.name: The War Within
ExportKeys.description: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.

ExportKeys.name: Call of the Tempestarii
ExportKeys.description: Void Storms gather in Corpus lanes... could a mysterious vessel somehow be the cause?

ExportKeys.name: The Waverider
ExportKeys.description: When tragedy strikes, the Ventkids search for hope in a long-lost story.

ExportKeys.name: Angels of the Zariman
ExportKeys.description: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...

Location: Bio Lab in Clan Dojo

ExportResources.name: Eidolon Phylaxis
ExportResources.description:
Sentient immunity to the Infestation is exploited with this refined phylaxis. Formulated specifically to combat Infested boils in Plague Star bounties.

Location: Nakak's Operational Supply in Cetus

ExportResources.name: Animo Nav Beacon
ExportResources.description:
Used to locate the Ambulas production facility.

This resource is dropped from Ambulas Units.

ExportResources.name: Scarlet Credits
ExportResources.description: Battle pay for Tenno fighting in Operation Scarlet Spear.

ExportResources.name: Ferment Bladder
ExportResources.description:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox

ExportResources.name: Tubercular Gill System
ExportResources.description:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid

ExportResources.name: Benign Infested Tumor
ExportResources.description:
The Infestation infects all fish on Deimos, even those that do not show any external mutations.

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).

ExportResources.name: Pustulent Cognitive Nodule
ExportResources.description:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Dendrite Blastoma
ExportResources.description:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Saturated Muscle Mass
ExportResources.description:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Waxen Sebum Deposit
ExportResources.description:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.

ExportResources.name: Sporulate Sac
ExportResources.description:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Ocular Stem-Root
ExportResources.description:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Parasitic Tethermaw
ExportResources.description:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Biotic Filter
ExportResources.description:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Spinal Core Section
ExportResources.description:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.

ExportResources.name: Cranial Foremount
ExportResources.description:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

ExportResources.name: MELEE UPGRADE SEGMENT

ExportResources.name: AUXILIARY FORMA CRUCIBLE

ExportResources.name: Landing Craft Foundry Segment
ExportResources.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.

ExportResources.name: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
ExportResources.description: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.

ExportResources.name: Incubator Segment
ExportResources.description: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.

ExportResources.name: Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions

ExportResources.name: HELMINTH ARCHON SHARD SEGMENT
ExportResources.description: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.

ExportResources.name: HELMINTH COALESCENT SEGMENT
ExportResources.description: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.

ExportResources.name: HELMINTH SEGMENT
ExportResources.description: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.

ExportResources.name: HELMINTH INVIGORATION SEGMENT
ExportResources.description: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.

ExportResources.name: Mod Fusion Segment
ExportResources.description: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.

ExportResources.name: Railjack Cephalon
ExportResources.description: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.

ExportResources.name: RELIQUARY KEY
ExportResources.description: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.

ExportResources.name: VOID RELIC SEGMENT
ExportResources.description: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.

ExportResources.name: SKAUT
ExportResources.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut’s alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad’s health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.

ExportResources.name: Parallax

ExportResources.name: TRAINING DEBT-BOND
ExportResources.description:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportResources.name: SHELTER DEBT-BOND
ExportResources.description:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportResources.name: MEDICAL DEBT-BOND
ExportResources.description:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportResources.name: ADVANCES DEBT-BOND
ExportResources.description:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportResources.name: FAMILIAL DEBT-BOND
ExportResources.description:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

ExportSentinels.name: Venari Prime
ExportSentinels.description: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.

ExportSentinels.name: Venari
ExportSentinels.description: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.

ExportSentinels.name: Wyrm
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.

ExportSentinels.name: Taxon
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.

ExportSentinels.name: Shade
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.

ExportSentinels.name: Oxylus
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.

ExportSentinels.name: Prisma Shade
ExportSentinels.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?

ExportSentinels.name: Wyrm Prime
ExportSentinels.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.

ExportSentinels.name: Shade Prime
ExportSentinels.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.

ExportSentinels.name: Helios Prime
ExportSentinels.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.

ExportSentinels.name: Dethcube Prime
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.

ExportSentinels.name: Carrier Prime
ExportSentinels.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.

ExportSentinels.name: Nautilus Prime
ExportSentinels.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.

ExportSentinels.name: Helios
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

ExportSentinels.name: Djinn
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.

ExportSentinels.name: Nautilus
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.

ExportSentinels.name: Dethcube
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.

ExportSentinels.name: Carrier
ExportSentinels.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.

ExportSentinels.name: Diriga
ExportSentinels.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.

ExportSentinels.name: Chesa Kubrow
ExportSentinels.description: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.

ExportSentinels.name: Sunika Kubrow
ExportSentinels.description: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.

ExportSentinels.name: Raksa Kubrow
ExportSentinels.description: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.

ExportSentinels.name: Huras Kubrow
ExportSentinels.description: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.

ExportSentinels.name: Helminth Charger
ExportSentinels.description: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.

ExportSentinels.name: Sahasa Kubrow
ExportSentinels.description: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.

ExportSentinels.name: Vasca Kavat
ExportSentinels.description: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.

ExportSentinels.name: Adarza Kavat
ExportSentinels.description: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.

ExportSentinels.name: Smeeta Kavat
ExportSentinels.description: This sly feline is playful yet devious.

ExportSentinels.name: Sly Vulpaphyla
ExportSentinels.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

ExportSentinels.name: Vizier Predasite
ExportSentinels.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

ExportSentinels.name: Pharaoh Predasite
ExportSentinels.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

ExportSentinels.name: Medjay Predasite
ExportSentinels.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

ExportSentinels.name: Crescent Vulpaphyla
ExportSentinels.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

ExportSentinels.name: Panzer Vulpaphyla
ExportSentinels.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

ExportWarframes.name: Rhino Prime
ExportWarframes.description: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
ExportWarframes.longDescription:
Red lights flashing on stark, white walls. Davis is running ahead of me, dropping his notes. We’re running for our lives. The fear gives me a strange perspective - I’m out of my body. I’ve forgotten how I got here. I don’t recognize this place.

Davis and I slam pinned against a cell door and he shouts at me. I give him a dumb look. I can’t hear him, the sirens, anything, only the muffled throb of terror in my head. I turn away from Davis down the hall and I see it. The hulking mass, flickering red, glinting like steel and fresh blood. Its skin changes, flowing like mercury when I’m blinded by the sudden muzzle-flashes. They do no good. The beast surges forward and the security men become crimson mist and gore.

I’m a statue, a cornered animal. A gate opens inside me and recognition floods in. I have seen this monster before. I have cut its shell and eviscerated its brothers. I have given it pain and measured its response. I have crafted then rejected countless like it. But I’ve never seen this beast so close, without the shield, without restraints. I have never seen it... free.

I know I will die so I just watch with curious acceptance. The beast squats down, shovelling a heap of gore into its mouth. It is watching me with vague eyes, a sense of recognition, ancestral memory. It knows who I am and what I’ve done. It rears up like a bear and roars, shattering the lights and casting us into darkness. I can hear it lumbering toward me, its metal fingers rending the walls, but I know I am dead. I close my eyes and stand ready to pay.

I feel the pull on my arm and realize Davis got the cell open. He tugs me into the cell beyond and I fall on my back. I see Davis standing at the open door, waiting, as the monster tears towards us.

Suddenly I could live through this so I shout, 'Davis, close the goddamn door!' - But he shakes his head with eyes wide as moons. He shouts, 'Watch!' over the roaring and rending of metal.

Then silence. Davis is panting, laughing? The beast fills the doorway, inches from him, dripping in blood, but still without violence. It stands there, looking at its hands. Davis whispers, 'No one would have believed me.'

I crawl up the wall to stand, opposite the door. I’ve never seen this cell, a cold place with an array of shelves. A morgue? 'Where are we, Davis?'

'This is where they keep them. The ones from Zariman.' I’m thrown, what was the Zariman? The ship that never returned? 'Davis, what’s going on?'

Davis turns to me a smile forming - 'What's going on is...' he turns back to the beast now silent and calm. '...big, fat promotions.'

ExportWarframes.passiveDescription: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.

abilities.description: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.

Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.

abilities.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.

ExportWarframes.name: Mag Prime
ExportWarframes.description: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
ExportWarframes.longDescription:
Warframe Archive - Debrief excerpt:

We sat strapped in, safeties off, waiting for the punch. Waiting for death. Through my filthy porthole I saw stars among the outlines of the other Splinter ships queuing for the Solar Rail. It would soon grip us with an incomprehensible power and cast us through the void into the mouth of our enemy.

I watched the ships one-by-one bending and gone. Each crammed with zero-tech soldiers sucking stale air, white knuckling their percussion rifles. Each filled with a desperation that comes from extinction. Our ship would be the last to cross the gap. Our ship had special cargo.

It was essentially empty. Just ten men, like me, strapped in with the best zero-tech suits and weapons the empire could build... and 'it'. 'It' stood in the aisle, a slender and eyeless metal form. A Tenno inside its Warframe. Vaguely human, vaguely feminine. Was this armor or some ornate carapace for the monster that lived inside? I strained against the harness as the ship yawed for final approach. I could see the Tenno standing there freely. Solemn and gold-gleaming, oblivious to the inertial force.

I had been, until then, a Tenno denier. They were ghosts, propaganda, twisted casualties of the void era. Not possibly real. Yet here it was in the flesh. The Empire, in their desperation, was going to turn the demons loose and hope for the best. Who did we fear more, the enemy or this monster? We had our safeties off, could we trust it? Then it didn’t matter anymore. The punch came - and our windows became blinding. When we could see again our ship was somewhere else, shattered and dead in an instant.

My lungs were flattened, eyes full of death. Ship debris glittered like a night snow. The alien blue star was dark and blinding beyond us. The countless articulating worm-ships of our enemy, ringed in glowing discs, undulating and heat-bursting the surviving soldiers like me. This is where I died. I was caught in R-disc, sweeping over my right side and setting my blood on fire. My vision flattened, the hearing muffled and buzzed. I could feel the side of my face going slack and wet.

I was in a dying dream. I saw a bright spot blurring and weaving toward me. I felt a tug toward it from the metal clasps on my suit. It reached me, rising up - a gleaming metal beast, a plume of golden wings rising and unfolding behind it. An angel. It snatched me from my death. I could feel my lungs fill as it wrapped me in its wings. Its Void Shield shimmered blue, strained under the enemy beams. I felt a sudden tug of acceleration. I closed my eyes and held on like a child.

I awoke on the floor, the sting of crisping flesh on my face and side. It was standing over me, the wings gone. I heard the cracking of weapons echoing down the corridor. Maybe the mission would be saved, but I was dying and so I waved my hand to send it away. I felt a pistol thrust in my hand as I was heaved to my feet. The angel had saved me, pulled me from hell, but it would not pity me. I was to die on my feet, by its side. I turned my good side toward the gunfire and raised the gun. It nodded, its outstretched metal hand surging and pulsing in ancient shapes as blue shimmered around me. It turned, drawing its blade and together we surged headlong into the hailstorm of death and fire that awaited us.

abilities.description:

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.

Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.

Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei’s dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

ExportWarframes.longDescription:
The Sentients had won. They had turned our weapons, our technology, against us. The more advanced we became, the greater our losses. The war was over unless we found a new way. In our desperation we turned to the Void. The blinding night, the hellspace where our science and reason failed.

We took the twisted few that had returned from that place. We built a frame around them, a conduit of their affliction. Gave them the weapons of the old ways. Gun and blade. A new warrior, a new code was born. These rejects, these Tenno, became our saviors. Warrior-Gods cast in steel and fury striking our enemies in a way they could never comprehend.

Excalibur was the first.

-Orokin 'Warframe' Archives

ExportWarframes.name: Ember Prime
ExportWarframes.description: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
ExportWarframes.longDescription:
Three figures waited behind a simple table. Their attention on a single chair, bathed in light. An old woman’s voice from the shadow: 'Send her in'. Across the room a security officer, stern and plain, opened the door. The outline of a young woman appeared at the door. She hesitated, but only for an instant, then crossed the room and sat.

There was a gasp as the light hit her face. Her right eye was bright and blinking, but her left was a greasy slit. Her skin had been burned moon-white. Her mouth was a sagging gash without lips or expression. Her military beret was pulled snug over a scarred and hairless scalp.

The old voice: 'Your name is Kaleen.' Kaleen nodded. 'You were the principal investigator of the Zariman?' Kaleen’s voice was a jagged whisper, a rigid face. 'Yes.'

Kaleen coughed, straightened: 'The Zariman was lost making the fold from Saturn to the Outer gates. Mechanical failure. I notified families and filed a report with the inspectors. Nothing ever returns from the fold, so I closed the case.'

'But you reopened the case, days later.'

'I didn’t believe it myself until I stepped aboard the ship. It was completely intact, full environmental, as if it had never left.'

'And the crew was gone.'

'Not exactly.' Kaleen hesitated. 'We thought it was empty but we began to find...' Her face twitched at remembered pain, 'We began to find children hiding in the ship.'

'And that is when you violated procedure?'

Kaleen bowed her head, a tear welling in her sightless eye. 'They were children. They were afraid. They needed comfort.'

'So you broke quarantine and this happened to you.'

There was silence as Kaleen touched her face, 'So what have you done with them?'

The old woman gestured for the officer to take Kaleen away. The meeting was over. When Kaleen reached the door she twisted out of his grip and shot back, 'Why would you do that? Why would you put children on a military ship?'

'We didn’t. That would violate procedure.'

Three figures waited behind a simple table. Their attention on a single chair, bathed in light. An old woman’s voice from the shadow: 'Send her in'. Across the room a security officer, stern and plain, opened the door. The outline of a young woman appeared at the door. She hesitated, but only for an instant, then crossed the room and sat.

There was a gasp as the light hit her face. Her right eye was bright and blinking, but her left was a greasy slit. Her skin had been burned moon-white. Her mouth was a sagging gash without lips or expression. Her military beret was pulled snug over a scarred and hairless scalp.

The old voice: 'Your name is Kaleen.' Kaleen nodded. 'You were the principal investigator of the Zariman?' Kaleen’s voice was a jagged whisper, a rigid face. 'Yes.'

Kaleen coughed, straightened: 'The Zariman was lost making the fold from Saturn to the Outer gates. Mechanical failure. I notified families and filed a report with the inspectors. Nothing ever returns from the fold, so I closed the case.'

'But you reopened the case, days later.'

'I didn’t believe it myself until I stepped aboard the ship. It was completely intact, full environmental, as if it had never left.'

'And the crew was gone.'

'Not exactly.' Kaleen hesitated. 'We thought it was empty but we began to find...' Her face twitched at remembered pain, 'We began to find children hiding in the ship.'

'And that is when you violated procedure?'

Kaleen bowed her head, a tear welling in her sightless eye. 'They were children. They were afraid. They needed comfort.'

'So you broke quarantine and this happened to you.'

There was silence as Kaleen touched her face, 'So what have you done with them?'

The old woman gestured for the officer to take Kaleen away. The meeting was over. When Kaleen reached the door she twisted out of his grip and shot back, 'Why would you do that? Why would you put children on a military ship?'

'We didn’t. That would violate procedure.'

ExportWeapons.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

ExportWeapons.name: Praedos
ExportWeapons.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.

ExportWeapons.name: Thalys
ExportWeapons.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.

ExportWeapons.name: Innodem
ExportWeapons.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

ExportWeapons.name: Phenmor
ExportWeapons.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

ExportWeapons.name: Felarx
ExportWeapons.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

ExportWeapons.name: Hikou
ExportWeapons.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

ExportWeapons.name: Despair
ExportWeapons.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

ExportWeapons.name: Kunai
ExportWeapons.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

ExportWeapons.name: Talons
ExportWeapons.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

ExportWeapons.name: Scyotid
ExportWeapons.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

ExportWeapons.name: Cantare
ExportWeapons.description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade’s Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

ExportWeapons.name: Castanas
ExportWeapons.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

ExportWeapons.name: Hikou Prime
ExportWeapons.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

ExportWeapons.name: Spira Prime
ExportWeapons.description: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.

ExportWeapons.name: Spira
ExportWeapons.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

ExportWeapons.name: Fusilai
ExportWeapons.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

ExportWeapons.name: Strun Wraith
ExportWeapons.description: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.

ExportWeapons.name: Strun
ExportWeapons.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

ExportWeapons.name: Hek
ExportWeapons.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

ExportWeapons.name: Boar Prime
ExportWeapons.description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.

ExportWeapons.name: Boar
ExportWeapons.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

ExportWeapons.name: Sobek
ExportWeapons.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.

ExportWeapons.name: Snipetron Vandal
ExportWeapons.description: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

ExportWeapons.name: Braton Vandal
ExportWeapons.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

ExportWeapons.name: Vectis
ExportWeapons.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.

ExportWeapons.name: Soma
ExportWeapons.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.

ExportWeapons.name: MK1-Braton
ExportWeapons.description: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.

ExportWeapons.name: Snipetron
ExportWeapons.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.

ExportWeapons.name: Latron
ExportWeapons.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.

ExportWeapons.name: Braton
ExportWeapons.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

ExportWeapons.name: Latron Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.

ExportWeapons.name: Gorgon
ExportWeapons.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

ExportWeapons.name: Burston
ExportWeapons.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

ExportWeapons.name: Braton Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.

ExportWeapons.name: Boltor
ExportWeapons.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

ExportWeapons.name: Kompressa
ExportWeapons.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

ExportWeapons.name: Epitaph
ExportWeapons.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

ExportWeapons.name: Knell
ExportWeapons.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

ExportWeapons.name: Velox
ExportWeapons.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

ExportWeapons.name: Athodai
ExportWeapons.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

ExportWeapons.name: Zakti
ExportWeapons.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

ExportWeapons.name: Pandero
ExportWeapons.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

ExportWeapons.name: Akjagara
ExportWeapons.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

ExportWeapons.name: Akstiletto
ExportWeapons.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

ExportWeapons.name: Azima
ExportWeapons.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

ExportWeapons.name: Aksomati
ExportWeapons.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

ExportWeapons.name: Pyrana
ExportWeapons.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

ExportWeapons.name: Akarius
ExportWeapons.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

ExportWeapons.name: Hystrix
ExportWeapons.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

ExportWeapons.name: Zylok Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.

ExportWeapons.name: Zakti Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A thousand pains, before their end.

ExportWeapons.name: Velox Prime
ExportWeapons.description: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.

ExportWeapons.name: Vasto Prime
ExportWeapons.description: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.

ExportWeapons.name: Akvasto Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

ExportWeapons.name: Sicarus Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

ExportWeapons.name: Pyrana Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.

ExportWeapons.name: Pandero Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.

ExportWeapons.name: Magnus Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.

ExportWeapons.name: Lex Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

ExportWeapons.name: Kompressa Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

ExportWeapons.name: Knell Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.

ExportWeapons.name: Hystrix Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

ExportWeapons.name: Epitaph Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

ExportWeapons.name: Ballistica Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.

ExportWeapons.name: Akstiletto Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.

ExportWeapons.name: Aksomati Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.

ExportWeapons.name: Akjagara Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.

ExportWeapons.name: Akbolto Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.

ExportWeapons.name: Akarius Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.

ExportWeapons.name: Afuris Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.

ExportWeapons.name: Magnus
ExportWeapons.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

ExportWeapons.name: Akzani
ExportWeapons.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

ExportWeapons.name: Dex Furis
ExportWeapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

ExportWeapons.name: Zylok
ExportWeapons.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

ExportWeapons.name: Ballistica
ExportWeapons.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

ExportWeapons.name: Euphona Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Banshee Prime’s signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

ExportWeapons.name: Riot-848
ExportWeapons.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple’s signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

ExportWeapons.name: Vasto
ExportWeapons.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

ExportWeapons.name: Lato
ExportWeapons.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

ExportWeapons.name: Lato Vandal
ExportWeapons.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

ExportWeapons.name: Lato Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

ExportWeapons.name: Lex
ExportWeapons.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

ExportWeapons.name: Bronco
ExportWeapons.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

ExportWeapons.name: Bolto
ExportWeapons.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

ExportWeapons.name: Sicarus
ExportWeapons.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

ExportWeapons.name: Bronco Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.

ExportWeapons.name: Furis
ExportWeapons.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

ExportWeapons.name: Spinnerex
ExportWeapons.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

ExportWeapons.name: Gunsen
ExportWeapons.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

ExportWeapons.name: Vericres
ExportWeapons.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

ExportWeapons.name: Quassus
ExportWeapons.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

ExportWeapons.name: Quassus Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.

ExportWeapons.name: Gunsen Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

ExportWeapons.name: Kronen Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.

ExportWeapons.name: Kronen
ExportWeapons.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

ExportWeapons.name: Boltace
ExportWeapons.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

ExportWeapons.name: Argo & Vel
ExportWeapons.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

ExportWeapons.name: Sigma & Octantis
ExportWeapons.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

ExportWeapons.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

ExportWeapons.name: Cobra & Crane
ExportWeapons.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

ExportWeapons.name: Tak & Lug
ExportWeapons.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

ExportWeapons.name: Silva & Aegis
ExportWeapons.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

ExportWeapons.name: Skiajati
ExportWeapons.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

ExportWeapons.name: Destreza
ExportWeapons.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

ExportWeapons.name: Tatsu
ExportWeapons.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu’s charge cap is increased.

ExportWeapons.name: Pennant
ExportWeapons.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

ExportWeapons.name: Dorrclave
ExportWeapons.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

ExportWeapons.name: Masseter
ExportWeapons.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

ExportWeapons.name: Endura
ExportWeapons.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

ExportWeapons.name: Okina
ExportWeapons.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

ExportWeapons.name: Broken War
ExportWeapons.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

ExportWeapons.name: War
ExportWeapons.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

ExportWeapons.name: Lacera
ExportWeapons.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

ExportWeapons.name: Ceti Lacera
ExportWeapons.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Keres
ExportWeapons.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

ExportWeapons.name: Tatsu Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.

ExportWeapons.name: Pangolin Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.

ExportWeapons.name: Okina Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.

ExportWeapons.name: Nami Skyla Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.

ExportWeapons.name: Masseter Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.

ExportWeapons.name: Nikana Prime
ExportWeapons.description: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.

ExportWeapons.name: Karyst Prime
ExportWeapons.description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

ExportWeapons.name: Gram Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

ExportWeapons.name: Galatine Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Keres Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

ExportWeapons.name: Plasma Sword
ExportWeapons.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

ExportWeapons.name: Pangolin Sword
ExportWeapons.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

ExportWeapons.name: Destreza Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

ExportWeapons.name: Vitrica
ExportWeapons.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

ExportWeapons.name: Karyst
ExportWeapons.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

ExportWeapons.name: Dragon Nikana
ExportWeapons.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

ExportWeapons.name: Nikana
ExportWeapons.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

ExportWeapons.name: Dex Nikana
ExportWeapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

ExportWeapons.name: Jaw Sword
ExportWeapons.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

ExportWeapons.name: Heat Sword
ExportWeapons.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

ExportWeapons.name: Galatine
ExportWeapons.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

ExportWeapons.name: Dex Dakra
ExportWeapons.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

ExportWeapons.name: Azothane
ExportWeapons.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

ExportWeapons.name: Syam
ExportWeapons.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

ExportWeapons.name: Dark Split-Sword
ExportWeapons.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

ExportWeapons.name: Dark Sword
ExportWeapons.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

ExportWeapons.name: Nami Solo
ExportWeapons.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

ExportWeapons.name: Nami Skyla
ExportWeapons.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

ExportWeapons.name: Tenet Exec
ExportWeapons.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

ExportWeapons.name: Zenistar
ExportWeapons.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.

ExportWeapons.name: Bo
ExportWeapons.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

ExportWeapons.name: Cadus
ExportWeapons.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

ExportWeapons.name: Amphis
ExportWeapons.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

ExportWeapons.name: Tipedo Prime
ExportWeapons.description: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.

ExportWeapons.name: Bo Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

ExportWeapons.name: Tipedo
ExportWeapons.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Raza
ExportWeapons.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

ExportWeapons.name: Hate
ExportWeapons.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

ExportWeapons.name: Reaper Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.

ExportWeapons.name: Ether Reaper
ExportWeapons.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

ExportWeapons.name: Harmony
ExportWeapons.description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade’s Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

ExportWeapons.name: Venato Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against “common enemies” of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.

ExportWeapons.name: Anku
ExportWeapons.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

ExportWeapons.name: Volnus Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

ExportWeapons.name: Venka Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.

ExportWeapons.name: Tekko Prime
ExportWeapons.description: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.

ExportWeapons.name: Silva & Aegis Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.

ExportWeapons.name: Ninkondi Prime
ExportWeapons.description: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.

ExportWeapons.name: Kogake Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.

ExportWeapons.name: Fragor Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Kamas Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

ExportWeapons.name: Orthos Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.

ExportWeapons.name: Orthos
ExportWeapons.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

ExportWeapons.name: Cassowar
ExportWeapons.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

ExportWeapons.name: Guandao
ExportWeapons.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

ExportWeapons.name: Guandao Prime
ExportWeapons.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

ExportWeapons.name: Amanata
ExportWeapons.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

ExportWeapons.name: Tonbo
ExportWeapons.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

ExportWeapons.name: Edun
ExportWeapons.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

ExportWeapons.name: Gazal Machete
ExportWeapons.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.

ExportWeapons.name: Shaku
ExportWeapons.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

ExportWeapons.name: Ninkondi
ExportWeapons.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

ExportWeapons.name: Magistar
ExportWeapons.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

ExportWeapons.name: Skana Prime
ExportWeapons.description: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

ExportWeapons.name: Skana
ExportWeapons.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

ExportWeapons.name: Ether Sword
ExportWeapons.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing’ infested allies.

ExportWeapons.name: Hespar
ExportWeapons.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

ExportWeapons.name: Wolf Sledge
ExportWeapons.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

ExportWeapons.name: Fragor
ExportWeapons.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

ExportWeapons.name: Sibear
ExportWeapons.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

ExportWeapons.name: Volnus
ExportWeapons.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

ExportWeapons.name: Sampotes
ExportWeapons.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

ExportWeapons.name: Redeemer
ExportWeapons.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

ExportWeapons.name: Redeemer Prime
ExportWeapons.description: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.

ExportWeapons.name: Sarpa
ExportWeapons.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

ExportWeapons.name: Gram
ExportWeapons.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

ExportWeapons.name: Orvius
ExportWeapons.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

ExportWeapons.name: Kestrel Prime
ExportWeapons.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime’s heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

ExportWeapons.name: Glaive Prime
ExportWeapons.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

ExportWeapons.name: Glaive
ExportWeapons.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

ExportWeapons.name: Kestrel
ExportWeapons.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

ExportWeapons.name: Ankyros
ExportWeapons.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

ExportWeapons.name: Ankyros Prime
ExportWeapons.description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

ExportWeapons.name: Tekko
ExportWeapons.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

ExportWeapons.name: Furax Wraith
ExportWeapons.description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

ExportWeapons.name: Furax
ExportWeapons.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Skana
ExportWeapons.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Heat Swords
ExportWeapons.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

ExportWeapons.name: Dual Ether
